sentences.text:
Dated this the 3rd day of October, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 to quash Annexure A Final Report and all further proceedings in C.C.No.533/2022 on the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Manjeri,
arose out of Crime No.261/2022 of Karippur Police Station, Malappuram District.
The petitioners herein are accused Nos.1 to 7 in the above case.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel appearing for the 3 rd respondent/de facto complainant, respondent Nos.4 to 6/injured persons and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3.

In this matter, offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406, 427, 458, 341, 323, 324, 354B,
506(ii) and 201 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 (for short, 'the JJ Act' hereinafter), are CRL.MC NO. 5638 OF 2024 4 2024:KER:73459 alleged to have been committed by the accused.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted that the matter has been amicably settled and the 3rd respondent/de facto complainant, respondent Nos.4 and 6, who are the injured persons, filed separate affidavits in this regard in a case involving matrimonial dispute.
The 3 rd respondent/de facto complainant filed affidavit on behalf of respondent No.5, who is her minor son, and one among the injured.

5. The learned Public Prosecutor also submitted that the matter has been settled between the parties and statements of the de facto complainant and the injured persons to that effect have been recorded.
6. Even though offence under Section 75 of the JJ Act also alleged, no serious overt acts to attract the said offence made out, prima facie.
Since the dispute has been settled between the parties, there is no reason to disallow the prayer for quashment, so as to facilitate peaceful living of the parties hereinafter.
Therefore, in the interest of justice, I am inclined to allow this petition.
In the result, this petition stands allowed.

Annexure A Final Report and all further proceedings in CRL.MC NO. 5638 OF 2024 5 2024:KER:73459 C.C.No.533/2022 on the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Manjeri, arose out of Crime No.261/2022 of Karippur Police Station, Malappuram District, against the petitioners herein, stand quashed.
